name: Kemoc
text: Kemoc is a shortened English form of the name Mo Cháemóc. Mo Cháemóc was a disciple of the saint Patrick. In the tale of the Children of Lir he brings the Christian faith to the four children after their long sentence.

key_results: Give the fuller form of the name.
Name the master of the disciple.
